entries.title: Isaiah 36:1
segments: Sennacherib--came up; the occasion of this invasion was Hezekiah's refusal to serve the king of Assyria.

entries.title: Isaiah 36:2
segments: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh; between this invasion and that recorded in the previous verse, Hezekiah had endeavored to conciliate the king of Assyria, as recorded

. 
 
  Lachish; in the south of Judah. 
 
  The upper pool; see note on

entries.title: Isaiah 36:7
segments: Whose high places--Hezekiah hath taken away; he confounds, either ignorantly or designedly, the high places and altars of the false gods with those of Jehovah.  See note to

entries.title: Isaiah 36:8
segments: Pledges; hostages, as security against another rebellion.

entries.title: Isaiah 36:9
segments: How then; that is, if thou canst hardly place riders upon two thousand horses.

entries.title: Isaiah 36:19
segments:
. 
 
  Sepharvaim; lying on the eastern bank of the Euphrates, above Babylon.
